simple.summary: זַלְזַל (zalzal) means tremulous , i.e. a twig First listed occurrence: Isa 18 5.

definitions.full: H2150. zalzal [ זַלְזַל ] noun [masculine] (quivering) tendrils ; — only plural tendrils of vine הַזַּלְזַלִּים Isa 18:5 (|| הַנְּטִישׁוֺת ), in figure of Yahweh's destroying the Assyrians.
